title: Surreal Clock Landscape
description: A person sees a large circular painting of a clock tower built on a green hill with a winding path, set inside a bigger round scene. The clock face shows Roman numerals and its hands point near ten to two, while butterflies, bats, colored spheres, and stars float in the sky above the hills and mountains.
prompt: A large circular surreal painting shows a clock tower standing on a green rolling hill with a winding path, set against distant mountains under a blue sky. A big round clock face with Roman numerals has hands pointing near ten to two. Butterflies, bats, colored spheres, and stars float in the air around the tower and hills. The entire scene is contained within one big circle on a light beige background.
